nodes.label: The Clock Is Occupancy, and the Tick Is k - g
nodes.rationale: Occupancy never rises along composition, so the object graph falls into three strata pure in occupancy with full circulation inside each and no return between them; cycles inside a stratum cost nothing and the downward edges are where the clock advances.

nodes.label: Definability Is Not Reachability
nodes.rationale: Over 2.7 million ordered pairs of Lambda_9, 11.4% are comparable, 24.7% joined by a composition path and only 0.4% by both: the lattice says what a cell is and composition says what it can become, so a cell can be fully defined and unreachable. Nine is not the dimension of time but the unique dimension at which time exists.

nodes.label: The Arrow Is Real and Is a Property of a Frame
nodes.rationale: Composition silently identifies electrons placed with electrons present, an assumption about destinations rather than a law of counting; representing both gives an equally lawful 13,775-cell index in which 31.6% of composable pairs raise occupancy. The arrow exists in the frame where destinations begin empty, observation selects the frame, and an index has one arrow per coordinate.

nodes.label: Arrow-Agreement Decay Theorem (tree distance bound)
nodes.rationale: Coordinates on a tree form a Markov random field, so conditioning on a separating vertex gives exact conditional independence, mutual information is non-increasing in distance, and Pinsker bounds the overlap. The hypothesis is separation: give the graph a cycle and the bound has nothing to bound.

nodes.label: Past-Present-Future Is a Path, Not a Triangle
nodes.rationale: Treewidth 1 closes exactly and treewidth 2 gives an envelope, so Lambda's exactness is itself a proof that the three parts carry no past-future edge; the future is conditionally independent of the past given the present, and the tick decomposes into something not removed and something removed but not placed.

nodes.label: rev(Lambda_9) and the Union That Does Not Exist
nodes.rationale: Reversal is a different object of the same size, not a sign change — the failure of self-duality read temporally. The intersection is a groupoid of 389 cells where g = q = k and time has no direction; the union would need 2,857 further cells, so a structure holding both directions at once is unavailable at any price this index recognises.

nodes.label: Every Lambda in One Table — Closure Is Never Spent
nodes.rationale: E = 0 at every stage, tested against every cell of the ambient box including forty-seven million at Lambda_13, while fill falls 14.12% to 0.42% because each coordinate multiplies the box faster than the object: the tower is not a refinement that sharpens but one that admits more room and fills less of it.

nodes.label: The Fourteenth Axis — Bounded Without Being Built
nodes.rationale: A constrained coordinate has mean multiplicity strictly below its own value count, so fill is monotone decreasing by construction and bounded below — convergence is a deduction. The stage ratios are not monotone, so the limit's value would come from the pattern and does not follow; leaving it open is the correct answer rather than a gap.

nodes.label: E(X) = 0 Is Necessary for Completeness, Not Sufficient for Content
nodes.rationale: The empty index is closed, complete and costs nothing, so every closure test in the book passes on nothing at all; what distinguishes Lambda is its seventeen generators and seven bits of surplus. The boundary is met from inside at the top of the tower exactly as it was met at the seed.

nodes.label: How an Index Enters a Larger Index — A Transition Becomes an Interval
nodes.rationale: A coordinate must be totally ordered, so only rank is accepted on Lambda_13: 199,130 cells become 44 values, 12.14 bits lost per cell, and only 17% of composite inputs determine a single output rank. Coarsening costs resolution rather than validity, and the branching is inside the index — ignorance about this index is not evidence of another.
